# codigate_workspace_branding (Resource)

Logo and accent colour on the workspace's login pages. One per workspace; destroying it removes the branding. Paid plans.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "codigate_workspace_branding" "this" {
  accent = "#0f766e"
  logo   = filebase64("${path.module}/logo.svg")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `accent` (String) Accent colour, lowercase #rrggbb. Leave out for the default.
- `logo` (String) Logo image (PNG, JPEG, WebP or SVG, at most 256 KB), base64. Use filebase64("logo.svg").

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Always "workspace".
- `logo_data_url` (String) The stored logo as a data: URL.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import codigate_workspace_branding.this workspace
```
